text: Collect your badge at the airport desk when you land. Past attendees report no queue there, while the venue line on day one runs 30 minutes or more.
Web Summit transport pass: 3 days EUR 23, 5 days EUR 31.50, metro, Carris buses and trams, urban trains. Sold only at Lisbon Airport next to accreditation, Nov 7-10.
Transport pass desk hours at the airport: Nov 7 09:30-22:00, Nov 8-9 07:30-21:30, Nov 10 07:30-14:30. Buy it on arrival, not later.
Skip the main entrance crowd: side and back entrances lead straight to Pavilion 4 and move much faster.
Everyone funnels through one security area; opening night is the worst. Budget 30 minutes and use the queue to talk to the people around you.
Send meeting requests in the Web Summit app before you land. Slots fill fast and the app gets noisy in the last days; 10 requests a day is a realistic pace.
Write one line in your app profile saying what you are working on and what you want this week. People read it before they walk over.
Expect roughly one accepted meeting per four requests. One journalist sent 13 interview requests and got 3; send more than you need.
Put your LinkedIn QR code on your phone lock screen. It saves 20 seconds in every conversation and works when the venue Wi-Fi does not.
Keep one private channel (Telegram saved messages, Notes, Slack DM to yourself) for names, links and the one thing you promised each person. Write it before the next conversation.
Follow up within 48 hours while people still remember your face. Connect on LinkedIn the same day with a one-line note about where you met.
Meetups by role or industry are where real conversations happen. The main floor is speed dating: 5-10 minutes per person.
Masterclasses and roundtables have limited seats. Arrive 10-15 minutes early for a masterclass and 30-40 minutes early for a roundtable.
Food on site is expensive and average, about EUR 16 for a mediocre lunch. Bring snacks or eat at Vasco da Gama mall next door; catering is cashless.
Most tracks break 13:00-14:00 and the food trucks queue at once. Eat at 12:15 or 14:30, or share a table with a stranger and call it networking.
Bring a bottle (refill stations inside) and a power bank. Outlets are scarce and the app plus 15,000 steps drain a phone by mid-afternoon.
Flat shoes and a waterproof. 2025 was the first rainy Web Summit in ten years and the venue walk is long; expect 10 km a day.
Stay in Baixa, Chiado or Bairro Alto if you can. Evening events cluster there and the morning metro to Oriente beats a taxi in traffic.

Night Summit 2026 runs inside the venue, in Pavilion 5: Mon 20:00-23:00, Tue and Wed 18:00-21:00, last entry 21:30, badge only. Coming from town after 17:00, use the North Entrance by Moscavide metro.

Night Summit Downtown is open to everyone, friends included: Tue 10 Nov from 21:00 at Quiosque Lisboa, Praça São Paulo (Cais do Sodré), Wed 11 Nov at Quiosque Lisboa, Príncipe Real. Wear your lanyard so people find you.
No umbrellas of any size at Night Summit, and only retractable ones in the venue by day. Lisbon in November can rain, so a hooded waterproof beats an umbrella.
No badge? Portugal Tech Week Palace (Rua Gomes Freire 98) runs free talks and after-hours all week, and most luma side events do not check for a Web Summit ticket.
Register for side events now. Hosts approve within 24-48 hours and the good ones fill before the summit starts.
Web Summit opens WhatsApp community channels (Women in Tech, country groups). Join one or two, not five; five is chaos.
Going alone? Carry one question, for example: what brought you to Lisbon this week? Then listen. Leave politely when the conversation is done.
Many evening parties hand out free passes at the host's booth during the day. Stop by the booth of any party you want to attend.
Open the Perks section in the app before you leave: cloud credits and tools discounts are included in the ticket and most people never claim them.
Export your app connections after the summit and put them somewhere you will actually look; the app is not your CRM.
Only small bags get in: laptop bag, handbag or backpack size. Bag drops are at the South and North entrances, so on your travel day leave the suitcase there or at the hotel.
Investors are flooded. Treat the week as relationship building, not fundraising: aim for second meetings in December, not term sheets on Thursday.

Collect lanyard and wristband at Airport Terminal 1 (Sat 7 to Mon 9, until 22:00; Tue until 15:00) or at Pavilhão de Portugal by the venue. Bring the app ticket and photo ID. A lost item costs EUR 100.
